data.name: Prathamesh
data.gender_notes: Prathamesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pratham means 'first' and esh means 'series' or 'supreme'. It is a name given to the first born in a family or a series of events. The name Prathamesh carries the meaning “First in the series, supreme” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Prathamesh usually hope their child will grow to embody first in the series, supreme and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning and the supremacy of the divine in one's life.
data.etymology: Prathamesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “First in the series, supreme.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prathamesh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

vedic_reference.note: Prathamesh is a name of Lord Brahma, the creator god in Hinduism. He is also known as Prajapati, the lord of creatures. This name signifies being the first and supreme deity.

historical_references.reference: The name Prathamesh is derived from the Sanskrit word Prathama, which means 'first'. This name was given to the first human being created by the Hindu god Brahma following the creation of the universe.

Prathamesh is also mentioned in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, as the name of the eldest son of the legendary king Shantanu of Hastinapura and his wife Satyavati. Prathamesh is known for his wisdom and courage and plays a significant role in the epic.
